dct_description_sm: Collected and maintained in a standalone access database by the Transit Branch of the Transportation Services Department of York Region. This is then converted into a GTFS feed. The feed is then converted into GIS. This data is used by corporate GIS Users outside of the Transit Branch as supplementary reference information for their specific GIS usages.
dct_rights_sm: Please refer to "York Region Open Data Licence", searchable on this website.
